season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep fits: logged successful ascents run Jun-Oct, peaking Jul-Aug; mid-July ascent was snow free; the high-country scramble needs melt-out.

track.why: Only route on the peak; 2026-07-16 summit, track starts 131 m from the FS 3160 road-end pin, reaches summit within 13 m, returns to start; ~1,240 ft gain and ~4 mi round trip match our 1,300 ft / 5.9 km Church Lake line.

otherTracksConsidered.why: July summit from Church Lake but the track starts and ends about 1 km from the trailhead pin (not a complete round trip); lower priority than the complete track.
July summit report with no track data attached.

facts.text: In July the last four miles of the Forest Service road to the trailhead are steep and deeply rutted; a high-clearance all-wheel-drive or 4x4 vehicle is the safe choice, and a phone map may send you to a different trailhead, so aim for the road end.
By mid-July in a normal year the scramble was free of snow, leaving a moderate scramble with class 3 sections along the ridge.

notes: Packet had 3 tracks, all July. No pin changes needed: trailhead pin is within 131 m of the recorded start.
